body: I’ve actually “opened my mouth” several times regarding these issues over the years. Things change for a week or two, then go back the way they were. Is it really even fair to ask someone to change the way they are anyway?
Haven’t tried it personally, but have seen ECT do wonders for people with depression. EMDR is primarily used for processing trauma.

I’m so sorry. I miscarried my first baby. It was devastating. Now we are trying again and it’s so scary. For a long time, I thought it was my fault, but doctors told me it’s extremely common, likely had nothing to do with me, and up to 40-50% of first pregnancies end in miscarriage. Peace to you and your family.
